control.description-key: PBS Hub host app H-5 and H-6: submit a report for a session (metrics plus screenshot, named by the app), fix a report sent back for revision, or view a submitted report.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: tolerancePct (5), requireAbsen (true), absenLeadMin (30), reportDeadlineDays (2), imageMaxPx (2000), imageMaxKb (1200).

property.name: HostJson
property.description-key: JSON row of the signed-in host: Title, NamaHost.

property.name: ReportJson
property.description-key: JSON with zero or one [Report - PBS Hub] row. Empty: the control shows the submit form for ScheduleJson.

property.name: ScheduleJson
property.description-key: JSON with the [Schedule - PBS Hub] row of the session: Title, Date, StartTime, EndTime, BrandID, StudioID, HostID, Platform, Account, Status.

property.name: EvidenceJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report Automation - PBS Hub] with the same Title as the report: the AI reading shown next to the claim.

property.name: ClockInJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Clock In - PBS Hub] for this host on the live day: ClockInDate, CheckInTime.

property.name: AbsenceJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Host Absence - PBS Hub] for this session: Title, ScheduleID, Created.

property.name: HistoryJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON rows of the last 20 reports of this host (metrics only), for the far-from-your-average warning.

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeletons.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: Canvas reply {requestId,status,message} for SUBMIT_REPORT, RESUBMIT_REPORT, DISPUTE_REVIEW and ABSEN.

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: SUBMIT_REPORT, RESUBMIT_REPORT, DISPUTE_REVIEW, ABSEN, OPEN_EVIDENCE, BACK.

property.name: UploadData
property.description-key: Base64 of the screenshot (JPEG, no data: prefix) that belongs to the SUBMIT_REPORT or RESUBMIT_REPORT in ActionPayload. Empty for other actions.
